draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.34, the 50th-best grade among 259 2023 draftees and 4th of 23 at DT. He went 26th overall, close to where his grade ranked. Published comparison: Dontari Poe. Testing standouts: bench press (94th percentile). College production: 1 sacks in 2022, 17th of 23 DTs in his class with stats.
